description: This file implements a React component for exploring and managing career path trajectories. It includes UI elements for filtering, displaying paths, detailed path views, bookmarking functionality, and integration with backend API for fetching graph data and path details. It also manages local storage fallbacks for bookmarks and persistent state for user preferences.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty string for nullish or non-string inputs.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Safely converts a value to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out invalid or empty entries.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given MultiversePathType value.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a descriptive string explaining the meaning of a given MultiversePathType.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a string matches one of the valid MultiversePathType values.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a given CareerPath matches the current filter criteria: title query, industry, and skills.

methods.name: normalizeBackendBookmarksToLocal
methods.description: Converts backend bookmark records to local format, sorting by creation date.
